title: Foundation Update Payload
description: The structured output returned by the AI extraction node in Step 2. This is a flat patch list, not a full rewrite of the pack. The merge Code node applies these patches to the canonical story_foundation_pack.

patches.description: A flat list of field updates. Each patch targets one field by dot-path. The merge node applies them in order.

path.description: Dot-separated path to the target field within story_foundation_pack. Examples: 'project_core.premise', 'character_system.protagonist.wound', 'author_preferences.pov_preference'.

value.description: The extracted value. Must match the field type — string for field_string, array of strings for field_array.

status.description: Confidence level based on how clearly the author stated this. confirmed = direct statement. tentative = raised as possibility. unresolved = author flagged it as unknown. superseded = author explicitly replaced a prior value.

notes.description: Optional. Any context, uncertainty, or reasoning from the extraction that should be preserved.

merge_rule.description: overwrite: replace regardless of current status. append: for array fields, add new items without removing existing ones. skip_if_confirmed: do not overwrite if the field is already confirmed. Default is skip_if_confirmed.

open_questions.description: New unresolved questions identified this round. The merge node adds these to the pack's open_questions list. Existing resolved questions are not affected.

contradictions.description: Conflicts detected between the new round input and existing confirmed fields. The merge node logs these and does NOT auto-resolve them. A human must resolve contradictions before the field status can change.

existing_value.description: The current confirmed value in the pack.

new_value.description: The conflicting value from the current round.

description.description: Plain explanation of why these conflict.

summary.description: A plain-language summary of what was learned this round, what was confirmed, and what remains unclear. Used for the human-readable round summary doc.

suggested_next_questions.description: Optional. The 5-10 best next interview questions, prioritized. The merge node can copy these into the next-questions doc.

why.description: One sentence explaining why this question matters now.

extraction_confidence.description: The model's self-assessment of how clearly the source text expressed the extracted information. Low confidence should flag for human review before merging confirmed fields.
